title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: ServiceNow Technical Consultant
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor (a) Senior ServiceNow - App Engine & Now Assist , com forte experiência em App Engine e Now Assist para atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações corporativas, automações inteligentes e soluções baseadas em agentes de IA em um projeto estratégico junto a uma equipe multidisciplinar de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.


A pessoa selecionada irá atuar em iniciativas avançadas de Hiperautomação e IA, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções para Automação de Processos utilizando a plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando App Engine Studio (Low-code e High-code).
  • Projetar e implementar workflows, flows e integrações (ITSM, App Engine).
  • Desenvolvimento de scripts para melhor aderência de soluções ao negócio.
  • Atuar na criação de soluções com Now Assist , explorando:
  • Assistentes de IA para ITSM, CSM e processos corporativos.
  • Automação de geração de textos, resumos, classificação e suporte a agentes.
  • Uso de modelos generativos integrados à ServiceNow.
  • Desenvolver componentes em UI Builder / Workspace quando necessário.
  • Trabalhar com scripting em JavaScript (Server e Client Side) .
  • Apoiar na definição de arquitetura de soluções e boas práticas de desenvolvimento na plataforma.
  • Participar de refinamentos técnicos, estimativas e definição de MVPs .
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança e governança das aplicações desenvolvidas.
  • Participação em todo o ciclo de vida de soluções :
  • Discovery técnico
  • Desenho e arquitetura de solução
  • Desenvolvimento
  • Testes e Deploy
  • Hypercare, Orquestração e Sustentação
  • Atuação consultiva com áreas de negócio e TI;
  • Apoio à disseminação de boas práticas de COE de Hiperautomação & IA;
  • Atuar como referência técnica ServiceNow no squad de Delivery;


O que buscamos?

  • Profissional com senioridade e experiência comprovada nos itens citados nesta.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica;
  • Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e inovador;
  • Gosto por ambientes de alta performance, transparência e confiança;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão de soluções aplicadas para os negócios.
  • Comunicação clara com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Mentalidade de inovação e automação inteligente.

Requisitos da Vaga

  • Experiência comprovada desenvolvimento na plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Experiência comprovada com ServiceNow App Engine / Creator Workflows.
  • Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer e IntegrationHub.
  • JavaScript para ServiceNow.
  • Consumo e exposição de APIs REST.
  • Experiência com Virtual Agent, AI Search, Process Automation Designer, Performance Analytics
  • Vivência em projetos de IA aplicada a processos corporativos.
  • App Engine Studio / Application Developer
  • Now Assist Specialist
  • Experiência com metodologia Ágil (Scrum / Kanban);
  • Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Application Developer (CAD)

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification
  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, and Tableau and knowledge of ETL.


InComm provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, age, disability status, genetics or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?

Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.

  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

description:

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Systems Architect – Prediction Market
description:
About the Role

Forkast is a prediction market where crypto traders and gamers predict real-world events. Real-time, high-integrity infrastructure where every millisecond counts. We’re looking for a hands-on Systems Architect to take our trading engine from exceptional to elite.


The ideal candidate has scaled production-grade systems at serious volume. This isn’t a whiteboard-only position. This is a high-stakes engineering role at the intersection of finance, crypto, and frontier prediction market systems design.


You’ll be solving performance bottlenecks, owning major redesigns, and championing best practices in distributed computing.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead the evolution of our trading engine, scaling throughput, reliability, and latency.
  • Design and optimize the integration between off-chain matching engines and on-chain settlement (USDC on Arbitrum).
  • Apply industry-standard approaches to distributed systems design, ensuring consistency, fault tolerance, and correctness.
  • Establish and implement robust observability practices, including tracing, metrics, logging, and alerting.
  • Design and scale data storage systems, including database partitioning, sharding, and performance tuning.
  • Guide the team in implementing complex designs correctly through code reviews, technical direction, and hands-on collaboration.
  • Step in as a builder when needed: implement performance-critical components, optimize in-memory order books, and improve messaging and data pipelines.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience scaling high-throughput, low-latency trading systems or similar distributed platforms in production.
  • Deep understanding of trading engine architecture, including settlement, batching, state consistency, and failure modes.
  • Hands-on experience with system-level performance optimization and distributed systems.
  • Practical experience setting up and operating monitoring, tracing, and observability tools at scale.
  • Experience designing and scaling databases, including partitioning strategies and data access optimization.
  • Coding alongside the team. Hands-on contributions, not just oversight.
  • Ability to guide a team in adopting industry standards and implementing them consistently.


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with prediction markets, decentralized exchanges, or hybrid CeFi/DeFi systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud-scale infrastructure, production operations, and large-scale data storage.
  • Familiarity with trading agents using open agent platforms like OpenClaw


Why This Role

  • Directly influence the architecture and scalability of a high-performance trading platform.
  • Work hands-on with top-tier engineers on genuinely hard distributed systems problems.
  • Competitive compensation and equity for a role with real technical ownership and impact.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into existing applications, understanding how they actually work, and improving them with pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.

You’ll work on production SaaS systems built primarily on PHP 8 and CodeIgniter , spanning application logic, data modeling, and frontend integration. We value engineers who think end-to-end, explain their reasoning, and treat the product as if they own it.


What You’ll Do

  • Own application features and fixes from start to finish — from investigation and design through implementation and rollout
  • Deep-dive into existing PHP/CodeIgniter codebases to debug issues, improve reliability, and reduce technical debt
  • Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
  • Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)
  • Participate in production issue triage and root-cause analysis when needed
  • Proactively identify improvements rather than waiting for tickets


Core Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with CodeIgniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks)
  • Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, MySQL/MariaDB, PHP, Apache/Nginx)
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas


Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic DevOps workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
  • Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
  • Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments


What We Care About Most

  • Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes
  • Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it
  • Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early
  • Comfort working independently without constant oversight
  • Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness


Experience Level

  • 5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications
  • Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)


Working Environment

  • Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
  • Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
  • High trust, low micromanagement
  • Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction


Why This Role

  • Real systems, real users, real problems
  • Autonomy to improve code and architecture meaningfully
  • Opportunity to be a true owner, not a ticket-taker
  • Competitive compensation with room for growth

Essa posição é para quem combina excelência técnica, visão arquitetural e liderança, atuando próximo ao time, produto e negócio para tomar decisões técnicas, orientar o time e garantir entregas escaláveis e de qualidade.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time, com protagonismo na definição de padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e boas práticas
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de desafios técnicos, removendo impedimentos e orientando decisões
  • Atuar hands-on em demandas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade
  • Traduzir necessidades de produto e negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas ao roadmap
  • Planejar e acompanhar entregas técnicas, participando de estimativas, prazos e priorização
  • Monitorar indicadores de engenharia e qualidade, mitigando riscos técnicos
  • Garantir práticas de qualidade, como code reviews, testes automatizados e documentação
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, com 1:1s, feedbacks e apoio à evolução profissional
  • Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e negócio, apoiando alinhamentos e decisões técnicas
  • Trabalhar em parceria com a área de arquitetura na construção de provas de conceito (PoCs) e na análise de viabilidade técnica de soluções.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados, Machine Learning e ML em produção (pipelines batch/streaming, deploy e monitoramento)
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas de dados e ML, avaliando trade-offs
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (modelagem OLTP/OLAP, Data Lakes, integrações e SQL)
  • Atuação fullstack, com backend em Python e integração com frontend em React e/ou Angular
  • Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica do time
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de IA agêntica, agentes, MCPs e integração com plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock).
  • Experiência com IA Generativa (RAG, embeddings, chains/agents)
  • Vivência com frameworks de agentes (ex.: LangChain, LangGraph ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em Data Mesh, governança de dados e sistemas de alta escala


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into existing applications, understanding how they actually work, and improving them with pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.

You’ll work on production SaaS systems built primarily on PHP 8 and CodeIgniter , spanning application logic, data modeling, and frontend integration. We value engineers who think end-to-end, explain their reasoning, and treat the product as if they own it.


What You’ll Do

  • Own application features and fixes from start to finish — from investigation and design through implementation and rollout
  • Deep-dive into existing PHP/CodeIgniter codebases to debug issues, improve reliability, and reduce technical debt
  • Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
  • Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)
  • Participate in production issue triage and root-cause analysis when needed
  • Proactively identify improvements rather than waiting for tickets


Core Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with CodeIgniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks)
  • Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, MySQL/MariaDB, PHP, Apache/Nginx)
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas


Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic DevOps workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
  • Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
  • Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments


What We Care About Most

  • Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes
  • Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it
  • Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early
  • Comfort working independently without constant oversight
  • Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness


Experience Level

  • 5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications
  • Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)


Working Environment

  • Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
  • Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
  • High trust, low micromanagement
  • Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction


Why This Role

  • Real systems, real users, real problems
  • Autonomy to improve code and architecture meaningfully
  • Opportunity to be a true owner, not a ticket-taker
  • Competitive compensation with room for growth

description:

Build Your International Career

If you want to work directly with the U.S. market, gain executive-level recruiting experience, and grow in a high-performance, process-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: GenAI Data Scientist
description:
Job Details:

Job Title: GenAI Data Scientist

Exp- Minimum 8 years

  • 100% remote/Long Term Contract/EST hrs.


Job Role-

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will translate the needs of our cross-functional stakeholders into user-facing applications that leverage NLP techniques and large language models (LLMs). As a Sr. Data Scientist on our GenAI applications team, you will work on products like conversational search interfaces, chatbots, text summarizers, recommender engines, and more based on the needs of the constituents. You will partner with Product Managers, Machine Learning Engineers, Cloud Platform Engineers, and cross-functional partners to develop production-grade algorithms.

You will contribute to the creation, delivery, and production of specific data science, machine learning and AI products for internal stakeholders; directly mentor other data professionals, data analysts, and machine learning engineers. In conjunction with the key partners, you will make technical decisions on data, technology, and ways of working

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Architect the overall framework and infrastructure for GenAI products like search interfaces, bots, summarizers, etc. Develop and implement techniques to optimize model performance to meet specific product goals
  • Collaborate closely with product management and engineering leads to align on technical roadmap. Guide engineering teams to effectively leverage LLM capabilities in product implementation.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation and business value. Proactively analyze latest developments in large language models to deeply understand model capabilities, limitations, and best practices. Develop techniques to continually improve language understanding and model training
  • Mentor and develop junior data scientists in state-of-the-art GenAI methods
  • Set technical vision and lead initiatives to accelerate product impact through cutting-edge LLM innovations
  • Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Total Exp: 8 to 10yrs+
  • Advanced degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, statistics, or an equivalent technical discipline.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience in developing machine learning models with a track record of creating meaningful business impact and working with multiple stakeholders.
  • Minimum of five years’ experience with Python.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience building production NLP and deep learning models using PyTorch/Tensorflow, along with using large language model architectures (BERT, GPT-3 etc.)
  • Experience building advanced workflows such as retrieval augmented generation, model chaining, dynamic prompting, PEFT/SFT, etc. using Langchain and similar tools
  • Experience establishing model guardrails and developing bias detection and mitigation techniques for AI applications
  • Proficiency with various prompting techniques, with a clear understanding of tradeoffs between prompting and finetuning
  • Experience with finetuning embedding models and tuning vector databases to improve performance of semantic search and retrieval systems
  • Deep understanding of underlying fundamentals such as Transformers, Self-Attention mechanisms that form the theoretical foundation of LLMs
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms and tools (AWS).
  • Experience operationalizing end-to-end machine learning applications.

title: Calypso Configuration and Environment Management
description:
Why Luxoft?


Luxoft has one of the world's leading Calypso practice.

We are a top-tier Calypso Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration.

We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered Calypso projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Our benefits:

  • Comprehensive health & dental insurance (Amil, fully paid, incl. dependents)
  • Remote / home office allowance (monthly)
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation voucher
  • Childcare / family allowance
  • Savings plan (FGTS)
  • Life & mandatory insurance (fully covered)
  • Profit sharing program


Project Description:

Support and additional build out for a greenfield Calypso instance.


Responsibilities:


- Develop necessary technical solutions for Calypso environments and instance on the cloud as per requirements

- Resolve Calypso environment related issues

- Stabilize Calypso environment with improvements and other services architectural changes

- Establish a comprehensive and integrated approach to defining, setting up, or trouble shooting issues arising from day-to-day activities on greenfield Calypso instance

- Create and deliver assigned projects / tasks and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements

- Competent in managing and establishing methodology and best practice for Calypso technical requirements

- Ensures supporting documents are complete, current, and appropriately stored

- Works closely with relevant business and technology stakeholders to ensure effective and efficient implementation of the project(s)

- Submits status reports to stakeholders; coordinates and provides updates to steering committees

- Collaboration with key functional or business stakeholders to achieve clear outcomes/deliverables in relation to the strategic and transformational book of work

- Manage deliverables ensuring transparency of risks, issues and dependencies that are fully aligned to functional / business owners


You might be acting also as a business analyst as well in order to help the team gathering and writing requirements, acceptance criteria.


Mandatory Skills:

• 5+ years of experience working in Capital Markets and Calypso

• Environment management, support, and optimization experience on Calypso

• Good knowledge of Financial products cross assets

• Proven track record of delivery of implementation / migration projects

• Proven experience in the development of Calypso integrations, reporting, and other technical aspects

- Experience of adherence to governance frameworks / implementation and handover to BAU

• Comprehensive knowledge of trade flow, trading systems and related concepts and technology, including valuation and client/market risk management

• Leadership skills

• Excellent analytical skills, understanding of project life cycles, and ability to act in an entrepreneurial manner to ensure the requirements from the business are gathered in the appropriate manner.

• Proven analytical, planning, problem solving and decision-making skills

• Comfortable with direct communication with all levels of technical and business resources

• Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

• Experience with working in a highly collaborative and dynamic multi-team environment


Nice-to-Have Skills:

• Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment is essential.

• Have a willingness to learn new skills

• Must have attention to detail

• Must have the ability to work independently and also as part of a group


• Experience of Agile practices and processes (e.g. SCRUM, KANBAN)

• Any technical knowledge (Writing simple sql query, be able to read code )

• Conflict management ensuring collaborative outcomes

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy


Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Spanish: C2 Proficient


Luxoft is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

We show fairness to all throughout our talent acquisition and management process.

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
The HR operations manager owns the execution and continuous improvement of HR operations across the full team member lifecycle — from onboarding through offboarding. This is a hands-on role that blends operational leadership, systems ownership, and process discipline.

You will work closely with the Director of Global HR , HR Specialists, and cross-functional partners to ensure HR systems, workflows, and documentation operate smoothly and consistently across countries.

This role is centered on building, operating, and continuously elevating a high-performing HR engine, with a strong commitment to operational excellence and ongoing improvement every day.


Must haves

  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience , with a strong focus on HR operations
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Location: Ukraine, Poland, Romania
  • Experience working in technology, IT, consulting, or service-based environments
  • Proven success building, running, and improving HR processes that scale with company growth
  • Hands-on experience managing HR operations for a multi-country workforce
  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms (HiBob preferred) and modern productivity tools
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace , and related collaboration tools
  • Exceptional attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions in a fast-paced, distributed environment


Nice to have

  • Experience supporting distributed, multi-country teams
  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO, or similar compliance environments
  • Experience using AI or automation to improve HR workflows, reporting, or efficiency
  • Prior people management or team-lead experience
  • Experience working alongside people / ER or HRBP roles
  • Exposure to B2B, outsourcing, or billable team models


Key responsibilities

HR operations & lifecycle management

HR systems & tools ownership

  • Own and administer HRIS systems (HiBob or comparable platforms) as the system of record
  • Configure workflows, task lists, permissions, and reporting in HR systems
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date team member data
  • Partner with internal teams to integrate HR tools with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, and other productivity systems

Compliance & operational risk

  • Ensure compliance with local labor regulations, internal policies, and HR controls across geographies
  • Own HR-related audit readiness and evidence gathering (including SOC2-related controls where applicable)
  • Maintain HR documentation, SOPs, and policy acknowledgements
  • Adapt policies and practices to meet regional needs while maintaining consistency

Manager enablement (process-focused)

  • Provide managers with clear guidance on HR processes, timelines, and required documentation
  • Act as the primary owner of HR operational questions and requests
  • Escalate judgment-based or sensitive employee relations matters to the director of global HR

HR team support & execution

  • Support, mentor and coordinate the work of HR Specialist or other team members as it relates to HR operational tasks
  • Prioritize operational work, ensure follow-through, and reduce single points of failure
  • Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency using existing tools and AI-enabled workflows


What this role is not

  • This role does not own employee relations judgment, PIPs, or conflict mediation
  • This role does not serve as a people partner or HR business partner
  • Strategic people decisions and leadership coaching sit with the Director of Global HR

This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Pricing or Computer Vision) 100% Remote, Fluent English (required)


Brazil-based | PJ Contract | Long-term


We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team on a long-term, fully remote PJ contract . This is a global environment with international stakeholders, and fluency in English is mandatory , as all communication and interviews are conducted in English.


This role is open to Brazil-based professionals with strong experience in Pricing/Optimization or Computer Vision , who are passionate about building and deploying production-grade ML systems that drive real business impact.


What you’ll do


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve complex business problems
  • Own key components of ML systems, influencing technical direction and architectural decisions
  • Develop clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to generate actionable insights
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies to build robust and scalable models
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders
  • Mentor junior team members and help grow domain expertise within the team
  • Contribute to the company’s technical leadership through research, publications, or patents


Minimum Requirements


  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s Degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Strong understanding of ML best practices (feature engineering, A/B testing, experiment design, training & serving pipelines)
  • Hands-on experience with ML algorithms and techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization)
  • Experience in at least one of the following domains:
  • Pricing / price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection & authentication, or marketing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with scientific and ML libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Solid data engineering experience with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with Big Data tools such as Spark, Kafka, Apache Beam
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure )
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world business problems, preferably in retail or e-commerce
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines
  • Strong sense of ownership, impact-driven mindset, and passion for high-quality ML solutions


Why join us

  • 100% remote work (Brazil-based)
  • Long-term PJ contract
  • Flexible working hours aligned with Brazil time
  • Opportunity to work on impactful ML systems in a global environment
  • Strong technical ownership and growth opportunities

title: Engenheiro de Software Especialista - GenAI & LLMs
description:
Buscamos um(a) GenAI Engineer com sólida experiência em Python e vivência comprovada em projetos reais de IA Generativa . O(a) profissional será responsável por construir, avaliar, implantar e monitorar agentes inteligentes , com forte ênfase no processo de avaliação e observabilidade de modelos em produção.


Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter agentes inteligentes utilizando LLMs (Large Language Models).
  • Construir soluções de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e orquestração de agentes para uso em produção.
  • Implementar e aprimorar processos de avaliação (evaluation) de modelos e agentes, garantindo qualidade e performance.
  • Desenvolver pipelines de implantação e monitoramento de modelos GenAI em produção.
  • Criar APIs e microsserviços que exponham recursos de IA.
  • Integrar pipelines de dados e vetorização para alimentar modelos.
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas de tracing e observabilidade para garantir visibilidade do comportamento dos agentes.
  • Colaborar com produto e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções baseadas em IA.
  • Implementar boas práticas de MLOps, segurança, versionamento e CI/CD.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência sólida em Python para desenvolvimento de aplicações de IA.
  • Vivência comprovada em projetos reais de IA Generativa , com foco em agentes inteligentes.
  • Experiência no ciclo completo : construção, avaliação (evaluation) , implantação e monitoramento de agentes.
  • Conhecimento profundo em LangChain/LangGraph ou frameworks similares de orquestração de agentes.
  • Experiência com diferentes modelos de IA generativa (OpenAI, Anthropic, modelos open-source).
  • Vivência com pipelines de embeddings e bancos vetoriais (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência em Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com a stack Databricks (Mosaic AI Gateway, MLFlow para evaluation e tracing).
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de avaliação de LLMs e métricas de qualidade de agentes.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de transcrição de áudio para texto de forma escalável (importante para projetos de saúde).
  • Vivência em MLOps e observabilidade de modelos em produção.
  • Conhecimento em fine-tuning de modelos LLM.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mensageria/filas (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS).
  • Certificações em Cloud ou Data/AI.
  • Experiência na construção de sistemas distribuídos.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;

  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

title: Líder de Transformação Digital & IA
description:
O turismo no Brasil está prestes a mudar. E você pode estar no centro disso.


A Orange Viagens acredita que o turismo é, antes de tudo, sobre pessoas com consultores apaixonados, clientes com sonhos e experiências que marcam a vida. Por isso estamos nos tornando uma empresa IA First: não para substituir o humano, mas para liberar o que as pessoas têm de melhor.


A inteligência artificial cuida do operacional. As pessoas cuidam do que importa: relacionamento, criatividade e encantamento. Para liderar essa jornada, buscamos uma pessoa que será a dona da transformação digital da empresa. Não como gerente de um time grande, mas como líder estratégico(a) mão na massa, com autonomia total e report direto ao CEO.


Você vai construir do zero. Vai definir a estratégia, implementar, medir, ajustar e escalar. Vai ser o ponto de conexão entre a visão do negócio, os parceiros de tecnologia e a operação, com o objetivo de transformar a Orange em referência de como tecnologia e talento humano, juntos, estão redefinindo o turismo.

Se você é do tipo que se energiza com autonomia, pensa como dono e executa como operator, essa vaga foi desenhada para você.


POR QUE ESTA POSIÇÃO É ESTRATÉGICA

→ Acesso direto ao CEO: suas ideias chegam direto a quem decide.

→ Construção do zero: a área de transformação digital está sendo criada agora. Você define o playbook.

→ Impacto real no mercado: o turismo brasileiro ainda opera de forma tradicional. A Orange quer mostrar que é possível usar tecnologia para tornar a experiência mais humana, não menos, e você será a peça-chave dessa mudança.

→ Ecossistema pronto para rodar: já temos parceiros de tecnologia, embaixadores internos e um roadmap definido. Falta a pessoa certa para conectar tudo isso e fazer acontecer.

→ Cultura de inovação e velocidade: sem burocracia excessiva. Decisões rápidas e liberdade para experimentar.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER


Estratégia & Visão

  • Definir e liderar a estratégia de transformação digital da Orange
  • Mapear oportunidades de IA em vendas, marketing, operações, financeiro e atendimento
  • Priorizar iniciativas com base em impacto, viabilidade e velocidade
  • Acompanhar tendências globais de IA aplicadas ao turismo


Execução & Implementação

  • Gerenciar a relação com parceiros de tecnologia, garantindo entregas e qualidade
  • Coordenar a implantação de agentes de IA na operação, do piloto à escala
  • Definir KPIs, medir resultados e ajustar rota com base em dados reais
  • Liderar a gestão de mudança: engajar times e garantir adoção real


Cultura & Pessoas

  • Ser o evangelista da cultura IA First dentro da empresa, garantindo que a tecnologia amplifique o talento das pessoas, e não o contrário
  • Criar rituais e programas de capacitação para elevar a maturidade digital do time
  • Coordenar a rede de Embaixadores de IA nas diferentes áreas


QUEM ESTAMOS BUSCANDO

Essa vaga não é para quem quer apenas pensar em estratégia, nem para quem só quer executar. É para quem faz os dois com a mesma excelência.


Perfil obrigatório:

  • Experiência comprovada em transformação digital, implementação de tecnologia ou gestão de projetos de inovação
  • Capacidade analítica forte: conforto com dados, métricas e tomada de decisão baseada em evidências
  • Perfil self-driven: autodidata, proativo, capaz de tocar projetos sozinho do início ao fim
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e suas aplicações em negócios
  • Habilidade de gestão de mudança: saber engajar pessoas e lidar com resistência
  • Excelência em comunicação: traduzir tecnologia para linguagem de negócio e vice-versa
  • Português fluente (inglês avançado é um diferencial)


Diferenciais que nos fazem brilhar os olhos:

  • Experiência no setor de turismo, hospitalidade ou negócios B2C de alto volume
  • Vivência em startups ou empresas em transformação acelerada
  • Conhecimento de automação de processos (RPA, APIs, no-code/low-code)
  • Ter liderado implementação de agentes de IA ou chatbots inteligentes


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Trabalho remoto, com uma presença mensal na sede em Sorocaba
  • Autonomia real para definir métodos, ferramentas e prioridades
  • Protagonismo nas decisões estratégicas da empresa
  • A oportunidade de posicionar a Orange como referência de inovação no turismo brasileiro
  • Uma empresa que acredita que a melhor tecnologia é aquela que faz as pessoas brilharem mais, e já está construindo isso na prática

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

A Designer on the Content & Engagement team is a skilled strategic thinker who is responsible for crafting highly branded and conversion-optimized creative across the divisions of Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
  • Work with team leaders and colleagues across Carnegie to optimize the team’s efficiency and effectiveness by identifying possible improvements to workflow, and scheduling
  • Champion project collaboration, working to motivate team members and ensure smooth and proactive interactions and processes
  • Design Development
  • Formulate clear and thoughtful content strategies to meet organizational objectives
  • Move design strategies to action, creating high-quality, highly branded, cohesive design constructs across communication channels (print, web, social, video, etc.) that tell a compelling story
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that champions client success
  • Cross-Divisional Strategy
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing as necessary to ensure that campaign strategy is understood.
  • Be well-versed in translating performance metrics into actionable takeaways
  • Represent content decisions on client discovery and presentation calls with clarity, confidence, and professionalism
  • Optimization & Innovation
  • Analyze conversion metrics to understand what resonates with audiences and drive content iteration
  • Contribute to innovations and improvements in client-facing products and services as well as internal processes
  • Foster a culture of innovation and creative problem-solving by staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and marketing best practices


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and highly developed collaboration, problem-solving, and project management skills to thrive in a fast-paced work environment with a large client portfolio
  • Ability to think outside the box to develop bold and innovative storytelling strategies while developing differentiated, compelling, and original creative work
  • Public speaking skills for high levels of client interaction and ability to listen carefully and navigate organizational politics
  • Consistent ability to critically evaluate the quality of creative work and guide revisions while coaching the best creative work from colleagues and direct reports
  • Thorough knowledge of creative tools, including Adobe, Microsoft Office Suite, and Google Office
  • Competency in prompt engineering and utilizing Artificial Intelligence tools, such as ChatGPT and Generative AI, throughout the creative process
  • Effective communication and time management skills for a remote work environment as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods
  • Thorough knowledge of print and digital communication development to effectively work across media
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or related field
  • 3 or more years of professional graphic design experience
  • Robust portfolio of design samples and case studies that demonstrate measurable success


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.
