title: Especialista de Projetos
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Executar os projetos da área garantindo o adequado levantamento de requisitos de demandas, classificação, planejamento e controle a fim de executar a entrega das mesmas de acordo com as definições de segurança.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Liderança e Execução: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de projetos, desde a iniciação e planejamento até a execução, monitoramento, controle e encerramento.
  • Planejamento: Elaborar cronogramas detalhados, definir escopo, identificar riscos e planejar recursos (equipe, orçamento, materiais).
  • Comunicação: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, garantindo a comunicação fluida entre stakeholders, equipes técnicas e áreas de negócio.
  • Monitoramento: Realizar o acompanhamento do progresso dos projetos, identificar desvios e implementar ações corretivas (turn-around).
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Gerenciar solicitações de mudança de escopo, avaliando seu impacto e garantindo a aprovação e documentação adequadas.
  • Metodologia: Aplicar as melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (tradicionais, ágeis ou híbridas), mantendo a documentação e artefatos de projeto atualizados.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Contribuir para a evolução dos processos e ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos da empresa.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 7 anos) na gestão de projetos de TI e/ou Negócios.
  • Conhecimento avançado em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (ex: PMI/PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban).
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e resolução de conflitos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.
  • Experiência comprovada ou conhecimento no ERP TOTVS Protheus.(Técnico ou Projetos)
  • Certificação PMP, CSM, ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em projetos de implantação, migração ou otimização de sistemas ERP (especialmente Protheus).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex: MS Project, Jira, Trello, Asana).


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: Network Engineer (Generalist)
description:
We are seeking a Network Engineer (Generalist) to join our IT infrastructure team. This role is ideal for a versatile professional who can design, implement, and maintain network systems across a variety of environments. You will be responsible for ensuring reliable connectivity, optimizing performance, and supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives.

Design, configure, and maintain LAN, WAN, and wireless networks.

Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure uptime and reliability.

Implement and manage firewalls, VPNs, and other security measures.

Collaborate with system administrators and IT support teams to resolve technical challenges.

Document network configurations, procedures, and policies.

Evaluate new networking technologies and recommend improvements.

Provide support for network-related projects, upgrades, and migrations.

Ensure compliance with organizational and industry standards.


Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network protocols.

Experience with Cisco, Juniper, or similar networking equipment.

Familiarity with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.

Understanding of network security principles and best practices.

Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.


Preferred Skills

Experience with network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Nagios, PRTG).

Knowledge of VoIP systems and network QoS.

Scripting or automation skills (Python, PowerShell, etc.).

Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

description:

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Network Engineer (Generalist)
description:
We are seeking a Network Engineer (Generalist) to join our IT infrastructure team. This role is ideal for a versatile professional who can design, implement, and maintain network systems across a variety of environments. You will be responsible for ensuring reliable connectivity, optimizing performance, and supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Salary: $3000 - $3500 / month

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Brazil Time

Employment Type: Full-Time



About the Role

As a Software Engineer, you’ll build internal tools, automations, and dashboards that eliminate bottlenecks and drive serious ROI for fast-growing businesses.


We’re an AI-driven engineering team. You’ll be using AI tools heavily to speed up development. Your job isn’t to write every line from scratch — it’s to guide the AI, review its output, and make sure everything that ships is clean, scalable, and production-ready. AI can write code, but only a human can exercise strong judgment around architecture, performance, and long-term maintainability.


You’ll own your projects end-to-end and see exactly how your work impacts real businesses — not in theory, but through direct feedback and measurable results. The tools you build will help 7- and 8- figure companies grow faster and save +$100K in expenses. If you want to sharpen your skills, make meaningful technical decisions, and be part of where software engineering is headed in the age of AI — this is the role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build custom internal tools and AI-driven applications that eliminate manual work
  • Build and maintain REST APIs, backend servers, and databases
  • Develop primarily with custom code (Python), using no-code platforms (Make, Airtable) where they make architectural sense
  • Create dashboards that give C-suite visibility into key business metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional backend software engineering experience (Python preferred), including shipping and maintaining production systems
  • Experience building REST APIs and production-grade servers
  • Experience making and defending technical decisions (e.g. database design, API structure, performance vs speed tradeoffs)
  • Designing and implementing databases (SQL or No-SQL)
  • Fluent English — written and spoken


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with No-Code Automation Tools like Make, Zapier, N8N
  • Experience setting up project management tools like AirTable, Monday.com, or Asana


Why Join Us?

  • Get hands-on experience building solutions at the bleeding edge of AI + automation
  • Work directly with founders and see how multi-7 and 8-figure businesses actually run
  • Build a portfolio of systems that save companies $100K+ per year


Please Note: This role is not a pure no-code or automation-only position. Strong software engineering fundamentals are required.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Implementação SAP
description:
CHAMADA ÚNICA – BOOTCAMP SAP CCS|PROGRAMA DE CAPACITAÇÃO


Não perca a oportunidade de fazer parte de um Programa de Capacitação exclusivo para um processo de seleção do BOOTCAMP SAP CCS - Customer Care & Service.

Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:


O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.


O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.


Vantagens de participar:

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento


Informações importantes:


Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python, SDK)
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.

This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Backend Developer in Brazil. You will join one of our North American client's engineering team to maintain, design, implement, test, and deploy new features in their Python SDK as well as fix bugs, improve, and update its existing functionalities. As an experienced developer, you will be responsible for writing great documentation, doing demos, and mentoring others. You will participate in the client's team ceremonies and other sessions.

  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • Experience working independently and remotely.
  • Strong experience with Python.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Public API and Python SDK on the backend implementation side.

  • SDK coding for other developers


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.


Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.


You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.


Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.


Vendor & Service Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
  • Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.


Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
  • Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.


Documentation & Enablement

  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or SaaS platform administration
  • Deep hands-on experience with AuditBoard or comparable GRC SaaS platforms
  • Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions
  • Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise SaaS tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST API concepts and SaaS integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AuditBoard Certified Administrator or similar)
  • Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
  • Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

description:
Estamos procurando uma pessoa de tecnologia de dados experiente e inovador para liderar a estratégia de dados e a execução técnica. Esta função envolve liderar uma equipe de profissionais de dados, discutir arquiteturas de dados robustas e garantir a entrega de soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta qualidade que impulsionam a inteligência de negócios e a eficiência operacional.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Liderar e orientar uma equipe de engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e analistas de dados, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.
  • Discutir a arquitetura geral de dados, incluindo armazenamento de dados, data lakes, processos ETL/ELT e estruturas de governança de dados, considerando a escala ideal e o tempo de lançamento no mercado.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escalonáveis e confiáveis usando tecnologias apropriadas (por exemplo, Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka).
  • Colaborar com produtos, engenharia, e equipes de negócios para entender os requisitos de dados e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados em todas as plataformas e sistemas de dados.
  • Impulsionar a adoção das melhores práticas em engenharia de dados, modelagem de dados e operações de dados.
  • Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados.
  • Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados.
  • Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico de iniciativas de dados e roteiro de dados de longo prazo.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado;
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, arquitetura de dados ou função semelhante com foco em dados, com pelo menos 2 anos em capacidade de liderança técnica.


  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência liderando projetos de dados.


  • Forte proficiência em SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação comumente usada em engenharia de dados (por exemplo, Python, Scala, Java).


  • Ampla experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Azure e Databricks) e seus respectivos serviços de dados. (por exemplo, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka) é altamente desejável.


  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar, orientar e inspirar uma equipe técnica.


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, interpessoais e de resolução de problemas.


  • Forte pensamento analítico e uma abordagem baseada em dados para a tomada de decisões.

Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager
description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
  • Construir e conduzir planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
  • Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco.

Relacionamento Consultivo

  • Ser a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
  • Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
  • Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução.

Operação & Execução

  • Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades.

Cultura de Cliente

  • Atuar com comunicação clara, cumprimento de combinados e foco em experiência (clientes parceiros);
  • Contribuir para uma operação ágil, simples e baseada em dados (planos efetivos);
  • Colaborar com times internos para garantir entregas confiáveis e melhorar processos continuamente.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Vivência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management, Consultoria, Projetos ou áreas correlatas;

  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;
  • Conhecimento básico a intermediário de métricas SaaS (MRR, churn, NRR, expansão, adoção);
  • Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;

  • Vivência em análise de dados ou uso de dashboards;

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.


Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior
description:
Cargo

Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações backend e frontend para plataformas de gateway de pagamentos e soluções whitelabel.

• Projetar, implementar e sustentar integrações com adquirentes, subadquirentes, PSPs e serviços financeiros via APIs.

• Visão sistêmica de plataformas financeiras e fluxos transacionais.

• Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas em ambientes de alta criticidade.

• Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade sobre sistemas em produção.

• Comunicação técnica clara para interação com times de produto, operação e negócio.

• Conhecimento de fluxos de autorização, captura, cancelamento, estorno e conciliação.

• Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Data Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Maintain and evolve Fraud Deflect’s data stack: reliable pipelines, strong data models, and stable production operations on Linux. Focus is improving what exists, not rewriting everything.


Responsibilities

  • Own data architecture and data modeling for core datasets.
  • Maintain and improve existing pipelines (stability, backfills, performance, data quality).
  • Build/operate Airflow workflows (SLAs, retries, alerting, idempotency).
  • Write and optimize SQL in MySQL (schemas, migrations, indexing, query tuning).
  • Develop pipeline/tooling code in Python.
  • Operate and debug on Linux (services/jobs, logs, incidents, automation).
  • Work within the current stack (Airflow, AWS, MySQL; ClickHouse is a plus).
  • Add basic observability; dashboards/visuals are a plus.
  • Communicate clearly; apply strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL (mandatory).
  • Airflow in production.
  • AWS experience.
  • Python proficiency.
  • Comfortable maintaining systems on Linux.
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.


Nice to have

  • Observability/visualization (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior Clickhouse experience.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

description:

title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.


Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.


Local : Remoto

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Software
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia criada para transformar o mercado de serviços financeiros no Brasil e na América Latina. Estamos crescendo rápido, integrando novos negócios, acelerando inovação e construindo com intenção e consistência a cultura que sustentará nosso futuro.

Cultura, para nós, não é discurso: é sistema, prática e forma de operar.

E agora buscamos alguém que venha construir isso junto.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


SUA MISSÃO:

A pessoa coordenadora atua como uma ponte entre a estratégia macro e a execução, garantindo que os times de Product Owners/Managers, Frontend e Backend tenham os recursos, a orientação e o ambiente necessários para entregar valor constante ao negócio.

Seu principal foco será o desenvolvimento de talentos, excelência operacional e entrega tática.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

• Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver a equipe, realizando 1:1s, planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI) e avaliações de desempenho.

• Alinhamento Tático: Garantir que as squads sob sua coordenação estejam alinhadas com os

OKRs da área e que as dependências entre times sejam gerenciadas com eficiência.

• Refinamento de Processos: Implementar e otimizar metodologias de discovery e delivery, garantindo agilidade e qualidade sem burocracia excessiva.

• Interface com Stakeholders: Atuar como ponto de apoio para áreas parceiras (Vendas, CX,

Engenharia), traduzindo prioridades e gerenciando expectativas de curto e médio prazo.

• Suporte ao Discovery: Apoiar o time na validação de hipóteses e na construção de roadmaps realistas e baseados em dados.


O QUE ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ SAIBA:

• Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor; domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); conhecimento em métricas de produto (NPS, Churn, LTV, conversão); experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Notion, etc.).

• Liderança servidora, habilidade em resolução de conflitos, comunicação clara e assertiva, capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks construtivos e organização multitarefa.

• Conhecimento básico em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação para backend nas linguagens Ruby on Rails, Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP.

• Noções de bancos de dados relacionais e linguagem SQL (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL

Server).

Conhecimento básico sobre o funcionamento de APis REST.

• Domínio de um framework (React, Vue, Angular) e seu ecossistema.

• Profundo conhecimento em gerenciamento de estado (Redux, Vuex, Zustand, etc.).

• Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack, Vite) e pré-processadores

(SASS).

• Habilidade em criar e manter testes automatizados (Jest, Cypress).

• ¡OS Nativo (Swift):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, VIPER).

• Profundo conhecimento em SwiftUl e/ou UIKit para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências (Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods) e concorrência (GCD, Swift Concurrency).

• Android Nativo (Kotlin):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, MVI) e dos componentes Jetpack.

• Profundo conhecimento em Jetpack Compose e/ou XML para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com Coroutines/Flow para programação assíncrona e Dagger/Hilt para injeção de dependência.

• Flutter (Dart):

• Domínio de padrões de gerenciamento de estado avançados (BLoC, Riverpod).

• Habilidade em criar widgets customizados e complexos.

• Experiência com canais de plataforma (platform channels) para integração com código nativo.

• Mentalidade Orientada a Dados: Capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.

• Empatia pelo Cliente: Um desejo profundo de entender e resolver os problemas dos usuários.

• Espírito Colaborativo: Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe com desenvolvedores, designers, marketing e outras áreas.

• Resiliência e Adaptação: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes de incerteza e mudar de curso

quando necessário.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Software
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia criada para transformar o mercado de serviços financeiros no Brasil e na América Latina. Estamos crescendo rápido, integrando novos negócios, acelerando inovação e construindo com intenção e consistência a cultura que sustentará nosso futuro.

Cultura, para nós, não é discurso: é sistema, prática e forma de operar.

E agora buscamos alguém que venha construir isso junto.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


SUA MISSÃO:

A pessoa coordenadora atua como uma ponte entre a estratégia macro e a execução, garantindo que os times de Product Owners/Managers, Frontend e Backend tenham os recursos, a orientação e o ambiente necessários para entregar valor constante ao negócio.

Seu principal foco será o desenvolvimento de talentos, excelência operacional e entrega tática.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

OKRs da área e que as dependências entre times sejam gerenciadas com eficiência.

Engenharia), traduzindo prioridades e gerenciando expectativas de curto e médio prazo.

• Suporte ao Discovery: Apoiar o time na validação de hipóteses e na construção de roadmaps realistas e baseados em dados.


O QUE ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ SAIBA:

• Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor; domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); conhecimento em métricas de produto (NPS, Churn, LTV, conversão); experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Notion, etc.).

• Liderança servidora, habilidade em resolução de conflitos, comunicação clara e assertiva, capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks construtivos e organização multitarefa.

• Conhecimento básico em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação para backend nas linguagens Ruby on Rails, Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP.

• Noções de bancos de dados relacionais e linguagem SQL (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL

Server).

Conhecimento básico sobre o funcionamento de APis REST.

• Domínio de um framework (React, Vue, Angular) e seu ecossistema.

• Profundo conhecimento em gerenciamento de estado (Redux, Vuex, Zustand, etc.).

• Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack, Vite) e pré-processadores

(SASS).

• Habilidade em criar e manter testes automatizados (Jest, Cypress).

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, VIPER).

• Profundo conhecimento em SwiftUl e/ou UIKit para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências (Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods) e concorrência (GCD, Swift Concurrency).

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, MVI) e dos componentes Jetpack.

• Profundo conhecimento em Jetpack Compose e/ou XML para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com Coroutines/Flow para programação assíncrona e Dagger/Hilt para injeção de dependência.

• Flutter (Dart):

• Domínio de padrões de gerenciamento de estado avançados (BLoC, Riverpod).

• Habilidade em criar widgets customizados e complexos.

• Experiência com canais de plataforma (platform channels) para integração com código nativo.

• Mentalidade Orientada a Dados: Capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.

• Empatia pelo Cliente: Um desejo profundo de entender e resolver os problemas dos usuários.

• Espírito Colaborativo: Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe com desenvolvedores, designers, marketing e outras áreas.

quando necessário.

Build Your International Career

Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Full-Stack AI Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: , Redux, Mui, -query, -table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment

Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.

Responsabilidades

  • Operar e evoluir clusters Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) com GitOps (Argo CD), garantindo padrões de deploy, rollback e controles por ambiente.
  • Manter e melhorar pipelines CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions) com pipelines-as-code em YAML.
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e empacotamento/deploy com Helm (charts e padrões).
  • Evoluir observabilidade (métricas, logs, alertas e dashboards) e apoiar troubleshooting ponta a ponta.
  • Atuar em incidentes, análises pós-incidente (postmortems) e melhorias contínuas de confiabilidade.
  • Operar serviços de plataforma como Redis e Apache Solr com foco em disponibilidade, estabilidade, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gerenciar segredos e credenciais com Azure Key Vault e AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Operar registries de contêiner (ACR/ECR) e rotinas de imagens Docker (pull/push, credenciais e políticas).


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de produção com Azure e AWS.
  • Kubernetes (AKS e/ou EKS) e Docker.
  • GitOps com Argo CD.
  • CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions (YAML).
  • Infraestrutura como código com Terraform e deploy com Helm.
  • Base sólida de Linux e fundamentos de rede (DNS, HTTP/TLS, balanceamento/ingress) para troubleshooting.


Diferenciais

  • Estratégias de deploy (blue/green, canary, rolling).
  • APM e tracing distribuído (ex.: Datadog/New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Práticas FinOps (governança e otimização de custos em cloud).
  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.


Modelo de contratação

  • Regime: PJ ou CLT - CONTRATAÇÃO URGÊNTE
  • Senioridade: Sênior
  • Formato: Remoto ou híbrido

title: Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS)
description:
Our US-based client is looking for a full-time, remote Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS) with 7+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the backend services and integrations that enable secure, scalable, multi-tenant embedded analytics within a SaaS platform.


This role sits at the intersection of application engineering, identity management, and the data platform. The primary focus is on integrating embedded analytics tools into a multi-tenant application with strict tenant isolation, SSO-based access control, and high-concurrency usage patterns.

While AWS QuickSight is the primary BI platform, we are open to candidates with experience embedding other modern, multi-tenant analytics solutions (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, or Superset). The emphasis is on a strong understanding of how embedded analytics work in SaaS environments, rather than on expertise in a single tool.

This is a senior-level role with meaningful influence over analytics architecture, security considerations, and integration standards across the platform.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-tenant embedded analytics within customer-facing SaaS applications
  • Build backend services that generate and manage embed sessions, URLs, and permissions dynamically per tenant and user
  • Implement SSO and identity propagation (Auth0, Cognito, OIDC) to enforce tenant-aware access and role-based controls
  • Ensure row-level and dataset-level security is consistently applied across embedded analytics experiences
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers to align datasets, semantic models, and RLS logic with application roles
  • Translate analytics platform constraints into clean, reliable application-facing abstractions
  • Design and maintain tenant-aware APIs that abstract analytics tools behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build service-layer patterns that isolate application code from direct BI or warehouse dependencies
  • Implement caching, pagination, throttling, and batching strategies for high-concurrency analytics traffic
  • Ensure APIs gracefully handle tenant onboarding/offboarding and evolving analytics assets
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design scalable backend patterns supporting hundreds of tenants
  • Optimize service-to-warehouse and service-to-analytics-tool interactions for latency and cost efficiency
  • Identify and mitigate failure modes in embedded analytics workflows (timeouts, permission drift, stale sessions)
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, integration diagrams, and design reviews
  • Enforce least-privilege access and tenant isolation across all analytics integrations
  • Ensure compliance with PII, data governance, and audit requirements in embedded reporting flows
  • Implement logging and audit trails for analytics access and permission changes
  • Partner with InfoSec to support security reviews and compliance initiatives
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for integration services and analytics-related configuration
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability through CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Improve operational reliability through monitoring, alerting, and runbook development
  • Act as a technical owner for embedded analytics integrations
  • Partner with Product to shape analytics capabilities and roadmap decisions
  • Mentor mid-level engineers on integration patterns, security, and service design
  • Drive standards for analytics integration consistency and developer experience


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in SaaS environments
  • Strong experience building backend services in Node.js, Python, or PHP
  • Hands-on experience embedding analytics or BI tools into multi-tenant applications
  • Strong understanding of SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and identity propagation
  • Experience implementing tenant-aware access controls (RLS, role mapping, dataset isolation)
  • Solid SQL knowledge and experience integrating with data warehouses
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment (AWS or equivalent)


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Experience embedding AWS QuickSight in multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Experience with other embedded analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Mode, etc.)
  • Familiarity with row-level security models and permission orchestration
  • Experience with Auth0 or Cognito in analytics contexts.
  • Knowledge of caching layers (Redis) and high-concurrency API design
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, or analytics access auditing


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP
