title: Senior Client Success Manager
description:
Senior Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Client Success Manager with 7+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 7+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Arquiteto de Soluções (Remoto | Temporário)
description:
Remoto, com viagens mensais (3 a 4 dias, Uberlândia - MG)

Tempo de alocação: 6 meses

Contratação: CLT



Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico focado na avaliação, desenho e recomendação de uma nova arquitetura de infraestrutura em substituição ao ambiente OpenStack atualmente utilizado.


Este profissional terá atuação agnóstica, avaliando diferentes alternativas de mercado (nuvem pública, plataformas privadas, virtualização tradicional e soluções hyperconvergentes ) e recomendando a opção com o melhor custo/benefício, alinhada às necessidades técnicas e de negócio do cliente.


A atuação será estritamente consultiva e arquitetural; atividades de execução serão direcionadas pelas equipes técnicas do cliente.


O profissional será responsável por interagir diretamente com times técnicos e também apresentar resultados e recomendações ao Diretor de Engenharia, exigindo excelente comunicação, clareza técnica e postura executiva.


Responsabilidades

  • Avaliar o ambiente OpenStack atual , incluindo arquitetura, componentes, integrações e custos operacionais.
  • Mapear requisitos técnicos, de negócio, compliance e governança do cliente.
  • Pesquisar, comparar e recomendar alternativas de migração tais como:
  • Plataformas de virtualização tradicionais (VMware, Proxmox, etc.)
  • Soluções HCI (Nutanix, Azure Stack HCI, etc.)
  • Nuvens públicas (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Outras distribuições OpenStack suportadas comercialmente
  • Elaborar arquiteturas de referência, desenhos de alto nível (HLD), roadmap de migração e análise de custos.
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas e executivas, apresentando estudos, opções e recomendações.
  • Garantir que qualquer intervenção técnica necessária seja executada apenas mediante orientação do arquiteto.
  • Preparar documentação clara e estruturada, incluindo relatórios de avaliação, comparativos e recomendações finais.
  • Atuar como trusted advisor, mantendo postura neutra e isenta de direcionamento a fabricante específico.


Requerimentos

  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto Cloud ou Arquiteto de Infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento sólido em OpenStack : arquitetura, componentes (Nova, Neutron, Cinder, etc.) , modelos de implantação e operação.
  • Experiência com pelo menos duas alternativas de virtualização ou nuvem, como:
  • VMware vSphere
  • Proxmox
  • Nutanix
  • Azure, AWS ou GCP
  • Capacidade de realizar análises comparativas técnicas, financeiras e operacionais.
  • Experiência em desenho de arquiteturas, modelos de alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e continuidade de negócios.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para apresentar resultados e recomendações para nível diretivo.
  • Forte capacidade de condução de workshops, entrevistas técnicas e apresentações executivas.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Certificações relacionadas a arquitetura ou nuvem (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Architect, Nutanix NCA/NCP, OpenStack COA, TOGAF, etc.).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de OpenStack.
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos e estratégia multicloud.
  • Conhecimento em containers, Kubernetes ou plataformas de virtualização moderna.

description:

title: Customer Success Consultant
description:

title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.


Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.


You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.


Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.


Vendor & Service Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
  • Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.


Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
  • Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.


Documentation & Enablement

  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or SaaS platform administration
  • Deep hands-on experience with AuditBoard or comparable GRC SaaS platforms
  • Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions
  • Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise SaaS tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST API concepts and SaaS integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AuditBoard Certified Administrator or similar)
  • Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
  • Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

description:

Estamos colaborando com uma empresa portuguesa de referência no setor do varejo , presente em Portugal e Espanha. Neste contexto, procuramos alguém com energia, responsabilidade e motivação para assumir a função de ENGENHEIRO DE API GATEWAY , numa das iniciativas que estamos a conduzir com este cliente.

Neste projeto, a pessoa que se juntar ao time irá trabalhar remotamente com colegas da FCamara e do Cliente baseados em Portugal.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Esta pessoa terá como responsabilidade assegurar que as plataformas de API Gateway do Cliente estão disponíveis e configuradas adequadamente para que os serviços de integração funcionem com alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança.


Requisitos e qualificações

Para esta posição, procuramos alguém com experiência em funções semelhantes.

Você é a pessoa certa se atender estes requisitos obrigatórios :

  • Conhecimento no setup e utilização de soluções de API/Event Gateway + API/Event Management (Apigee, Kong, Gravitee, etc.);
  • Experiência com Git e pipelines CI/CD (Argo CD, Github Actions, etc.);
  • Experiência na utilização de plataformas de observabilidade;


e iremos olhar com muito bons olhos se também atender estes requisitos valorizados

  • Experiência em ambientes com elevado volume de transações e integrações

Para além do conhecimento técnico, também esperamos que tenhas um perfil de colaboração e trabalho em equipe :

  • Capacidade para compreender os requisitos e as soluções técnicas
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação
  • Espírito crítico e foco na melhoria contínua
  • Forte orientação para a entrega e cumprimento de prazos e objetivos

Informações adicionais

Esta posição está inserida num projeto de longa duração .

Idiomas: Nesta posição, o trabalho decorre em língua portuguesa . Inglês será valorizado, especialmente para interações em contexto internacional.

Modelo de Contratação: Temos flexibilidade no modelo de contratação. A nossa equipe de recrutamento fornecerá todos os detalhes e informações sobre o tipo de contrato, remuneração e benefícios, ajustados à tua localização e situação profissional.

Nacionalidade, Residência e Visto: Esta posição não contempla apoio, por parte da FCamara, na obtenção de visto ou autorização de residência para Portugal ou qualquer outro país.

title: Gerente Soluções SAP
description:
A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Gerente Soluções – SAP


Local: Híbrido 2 vezes por semana em São Paulo (Capital).

Horário: 09:00 – 18:00.


Buscamos Gerente Soluções SAP Sênior, para integrar nosso time de pré-vendas. O profissional atuará em apoio direto à área comercial, definindo estratégias técnicas, coordenando entregas e garantindo propostas competitivas e aderentes às necessidades dos clientes.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas para identificar oportunidades e desenvolver estratégias SAP para os clientes;
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de produtos para clientes potenciais, destacando benefícios e funcionalidades das soluções SAP;
  • Avaliar e compreender os requisitos SAP dos clientes e oferecer recomendações de soluções adequadas;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia e desenvolvimento para garantir que as soluções oferecidas atendam às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Elaborar custeio e precificação de soluções SAP, garantindo competitividade e adequação ao mercado;
  • Compreender e gerenciar o ciclo de venda, desde a identificação de oportunidades até o fechamento de contratos;
  • Desenvolver propostas técnicas e comerciais para empresas públicas e privadas, garantindo o cumprimento dos requisitos regulatórios e das especificações do cliente;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de propostas técnicas e documentos de resposta a RFPs/RFIs;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias em SAP e disseminar conhecimento na equipe.


Requisitos:

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Software Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You’ll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic DevOps mindset.


Responsibilities

  • Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
  • Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
  • Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
  • Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
  • Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in JavaScript where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).
  • Meet and maintain contact directly with clients.
  • Operate services on Linux: deployments, debugging, performance tuning, incident response, and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, safe rollouts, observability (logs/metrics/traces), and operational automation.


Required

  • Expert Python backend engineer (3.12+ preferred): strong typing, testing, concurrency fundamentals, and performance debugging.
  • Proven REST API development experience (design + production operations), including integrations and webhooks.
  • Strong data structures and API data modeling skills (clear contracts, backward compatibility, validations).
  • Experience implementing business logic for payments/fintech workflows, especially disputes/chargebacks and reconciliations.
  • Comfortable on Linux servers with a DevOps mindset (deploy/run/debug production services; automate operational work).
  • Client-facing technical communication: can interface with external stakeholders to clarify requirements, diagnose issues, and drive resolutions.
  • Ownership mentality and interest in leadership: drive the full lifecycle from discovery → design → build → operate.


Nice to have

  • JavaScript experience beyond basics (instrumentation, performance, privacy-aware collection) for client integrations.
  • Containerization/orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and cloud-native operations on Amazon Web Services.
  • Event-driven/workflow systems (SQS/Kafka/Kinesis; Airflow/Prefect/Dagster).
  • Security/compliance exposure (PCI, SOC 2) and observability tooling at scale.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:

  • Python backend API development + real-world API integrations
  • Payments/disputes/chargebacks or similarly complex workflow automation
  • Linux/DevOps experience running production services
  • Any JavaScript instrumentation work and client-facing delivery experience

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join the Prosigliere team.


Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of data warehousing principles, ETL processes, and database management, with a strong focus on ensuring data quality, accessibility, and performance to support our analytical and reporting needs. You will play a critical role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, empowering our data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines using various data integration techniques to ingest, transform, and load data from diverse sources into our data warehouse.
  • Manage and optimize data models and structures within Snowflake, ensuring strategic organization for performance, cost-efficiency, and ease of consumption by analytics and reporting tools.
  • Administer and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Develop, monitor, and troubleshoot data workflows and orchestrations using Apache Airflow to ensure timely and reliable data delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency by implementing robust data validation, cleansing, and monitoring processes.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing Tableau reports, and develop new, insightful dashboards and visualizations to meet business needs.
  • Implement and maintain data governance best practices, including data security, privacy, and compliance.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to architectural discussions, and promote best practices in data engineering.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform and processes.


Technology Requirements

  • Databases: Strong expertise in PostgreSQL and extensive experience with Snowflake data warehousing.
  • Orchestration: Proficient in using Apache Airflow for workflow management and scheduling.
  • ETL/ELT: Proven experience in designing and implementing efficient ETL/ELT processes.
  • Business Intelligence: Hands-on experience with Tableau for report troubleshooting and development.
  • Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, scripting, and automation.
  • Cloud Platforms: Experience with at least one major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their data-related services (e.g., S3, EC2, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery).
  • Data Concepts: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, data lakes, and data marts.
  • Version Control: Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • SQL: Advanced SQL writing and optimization skills.
  • Big Data Technologies (Plus): Familiarity with big data technologies like Spark, Kafka, or similar is a plus.


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.

title: Gerente de Operações Financeiras (Financial Operations Manager)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal audit and legal standards.
  • Collect and organize data for regulatory reporting to Receita Federal and the Central Bank of Brazil.
  • Monitor tax and foreign exchange compliance risks related to stablecoin-based transactions, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Handle foreign exchange filings and reports for cross-border crypto transactions (e.g., RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
  • Assist in interpreting local regulatory developments and aligning operational processes accordingly.
  • Provide financial and operational insights to support management in budgeting and strategic planning.
  • Support internal reporting, KPI tracking, and process documentation.
  • Effectively utilize financial operations software, crypto custody tools, and dashboards.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

  • Job type: Full Time


﻿Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, acompanhamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
  • Coordenar junto às empresas de contabilidade a escrituração, preparação de documentos, arquivos SPED e submissões fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com auditorias internas e padrões legais.
  • Coletar e organizar dados para relatórios regulatórios à Receita Federal e ao Banco Central do Brasil.
  • Monitorar riscos de conformidade fiscal e cambial relacionados a transações com stablecoins e escalar problemas conforme necessário.
  • Gerenciar registros cambiais e relatórios para transações transfronteiriças de criptomoedas (ex: RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
  • Auxiliar na interpretação de novas regulações locais e alinhar os processos operacionais de acordo.
  • Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico.
  • Apoiar relatórios internos, rastreamento de KPIs e documentação de processos.
  • Utilizar efetivamente softwares de operações financeiras, ferramentas de custódia de cripto e dashboards.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Familiaridade com relatórios financeiros brasileiros (SPED, Receita Federal, Banco Central) e conformidade fiscal (tax compliance).
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
  • A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

Proatividade, capacidade de trabalho em equipe, capacidade de autogerenciamento e tomada de decisão, capacidade de comunicação (capacidade de se expressar oralmente e por escrito com precisão e clareza e de compreender com facilidade mensagens escritas e faladas).

Oracle Certified Professional – Java SE Programmer (versão 5 ou superior).

CSD – Certified Scrum Developer PSD – Professional Scrum Developer

title: Digital Experience Engineer (Nexthink)
description:

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O profissional será responsável por configurar a plataforma, desenvolver automações e casos de uso orientados à experiência, analisar o DEX Score , identificar oportunidades de melhoria e habilitar remediações proativas por meio dos recursos do Nexthink.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar e evoluir a plataforma Nexthink (configurações, governança e novos recursos).
  • Criar e implementar casos de uso Nexthink para observabilidade, automação, compliance e melhoria da experiência digital.
  • Monitorar e analisar DEX Score , performance de dispositivos e indicadores de experiência do usuário.
  • Desenvolver Remote Actions , campanhas e automações com Nexthink Flow .
  • Habilitar remediações proativas e apoiar a resolução de incidentes junto aos times de TI.
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios para times operacionais e liderança.
  • Promover boas práticas e adoção do Nexthink entre as equipes.
  • Colaborar com áreas de TI e negócio para transformar insights em ações.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Nexthink (Remote Actions, Flow, NQL, dashboards).
  • PowerShell avançado .
  • Integração via APIs REST .
  • Troubleshooting de endpoints Windows .
  • Capacidade analítica e identificação de causa raiz.
  • Conhecimentos básicos em cloud (Azure é diferencial).
  • Experiência com Intune / Microsoft 365 é um diferencial.
  • Inglês AVANÇADO/FLUENTE (Obrigatório)


Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara e boa capacidade de documentação.
  • Forte colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Perfil analítico, orientado a melhoria contínua.
  • Flexibilidade para aprender novas tecnologias, recursos de IA e práticas de observabilidade.
  • Foco em experiência do usuário e qualidade do serviço.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

title: Analytics Engineer Pleno (CLT) | Remoto
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Engenheira Analítica de Dados Pleno para compor o time de Engenharia Analítica do Gran e mudar vidas com a gente!


O Gran é um ecossistema que une educação e tecnologia , que acelera e customiza o aprendizado para diferentes necessidades e momentos e que já impactou mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Hoje temos 2 verticais principais: a de Cursos Preparatórios e a Gran Faculdade.


Atualmente, são mais de 820 mil alunos e alunas , presentes em mais de 1.500 municípios brasileiros . Temos como motivação possibilitar uma educação de alta qualidade que seja diversa e inclusiva, geográfica e economicamente. Nossa tecnologia de ponta é um catalisador que impulsiona para muitas possibilidades de futuro.


Somos grandes defensores da ideia de que a educação é um direito de todos e fazemos o máximo para tornar isso uma realidade Brasil afora. Sabemos que a educação é a chave para muitos futuros possíveis e temos as ferramentas que facilitam o acesso de milhares de brasileiros ao ensino, em vários níveis.


Essa vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalho Gran Mundo , sendo 100% remoto. Dessa forma, você não precisa comparecer ao escritório, apenas em casos eventuais que serão avisados com antecedência e custeados pelo próprio Gran.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, uma empresa Marlabs, é uma consultoria global de IA e Análise de Dados que capacita organizações em todo o mundo a alcançar melhores resultados por meio de dados e tecnologia. Desde 2005, fazemos parceria com algumas das maiores entidades dos setores de saúde, ciências da vida, serviços financeiros e governo em todo o mundo. Temos uma oportunidade empolgante para um(a) Líder de Engenharia de Software altamente qualificado(a) se juntar à nossa equipe inovadora e dinâmica.


Tipo de Contrato : Tempo Integral

Localização : Brasil – Remoto

Indústria : TI & Serviços


Esta posição exige habilidades avançadas de comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.


Lead Software Engineer | Sobre Você

Como Lead Software Engineer, você é responsável por impulsionar a visão técnica por trás de aplicações modernas e escaláveis, enquanto orienta uma equipe de engenharia de alta performance. Você prospera na interseção entre arquitetura, desenvolvimento prático e mentoria, equilibrando decisões estratégicas com a paixão por construir software de excelência.

Você gosta de definir padrões de engenharia, elevar as capacidades da equipe e tomar decisões conscientes que influenciam o sucesso do produto a longo prazo.

É motivado(a) por resolver desafios técnicos complexos e criar ambientes onde os engenheiros possam realizar o seu melhor trabalho.


Lead Software Engineer | Atividades do Dia a Dia

  • Liderar o design e desenvolvimento de aplicações complexas e escaláveis usando .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript, como Angular ou React.
  • Definir padrões de engenharia, melhores práticas e diretrizes arquiteturais para a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Arquitetar e manter sistemas na nuvem seguros, de alta disponibilidade e otimizados para desempenho.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Produto, QA e DevOps para garantir alinhamento entre as soluções técnicas e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Orientar engenheiros, promovendo aprendizado contínuo, qualidade na execução e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Realizar revisões de código para garantir aderência aos padrões de qualidade, segurança e manutenibilidade.
  • Resolver desafios técnicos avançados e influenciar decisões relacionadas à arquitetura e seleção de tecnologias.


Lead Software Engineer | Habilidades & Experiência

  • 7+ anos de experiência em engenharia de software, com proficiência avançada em .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript (Angular ou React).
  • Experiência comprovada liderando equipes de engenharia e colaborando efetivamente entre diferentes áreas.
  • Forte expertise em TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 e padrões modernos de desenvolvimento web.
  • Experiência prática no deploy e otimização de aplicações na AWS ou outras grandes plataformas de nuvem.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de sistemas, padrões de design e princípios de aplicações escaláveis.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team


Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

• Reduction in system errors or failures

• Time to resolve technical issues

• Successful internalization of GHL management

• System scalability and performance metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

• Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors

• Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations

• Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)


Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: M&A Advisor
description:
Expanda sua Prática de M&A: Una-se à Rede Internacional da ONEtoONE Corporate Finance


Conecte sua expertise ao mercado global. Transforme sua assessoria local em uma potência internacional.


A ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida assessores de M&A e boutiques independentes de renome no Brasil a integrarem nossa rede global. Combinamos tecnologia de ponta, colaboração internacional e um back office completo para potencializar sua originação e execução de deals no middle-market.


Quem Somos


Somos uma rede internacional de investment banking especializada em assessoria de M&A para o middle-market. Conectamos mais de 150 assessores em mais de 80 cidades ao redor do mundo, com foco em transações cross-border.


Nota Importante: Esta é uma oportunidade de Membership (Afiliação) para profissionais e firmas independentes; não se trata de uma vaga de emprego (CLT) ou prestação de serviços terceirizados.


Ferramentas e Suporte de Classe Mundial


Ao longo de duas décadas, a ONEtoONE investiu no desenvolvimento de ferramentas exclusivas que permitem aos nossos membros:


  • Originação de Elite: Conquiste mais e melhores mandatos.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Identifique compradores ou targets ideais globalmente.
  • Back Office Dedicado: Suporte em todas as fases — desde o pitch e análise financeira até a documentação e busca de contrapartes.
  • Dados Premium: Acesso a perfis de mais de 450 milhões de empresas e dados de transações globais.


Colaboração Sem Fronteiras


No Brasil, o relacionamento é a base de tudo. Nossa rede permite que você colabore com especialistas em diversos setores e países sem restrições geográficas ou setoriais. Você terá a liberdade de operar globalmente, utilizando ferramentas de IA e bancos de dados proprietários para multiplicar seu alcance e sua receita.


Perfil Ideal


Buscamos profissionais brasileiros com o seguinte perfil:


  • Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em Corporate Finance, Private Equity, M&A ou assessoria transacional.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado/fluente (essencial para colaboração internacional).
  • Mindset: Perfil empreendedor, proativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Expertise: Forte rede de relacionamentos local e capacidade analítica.
  • Visão: Desejo de portar uma marca global de investment banking e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


O Que Você Ganha


  • Suporte Full Back Office: Originadores, analistas e especialistas em marketing, jurídico e TI à sua disposição.
  • Tecnologia de Ponta: Acesso às melhores bases de dados de M&A do mundo e ferramentas de IA exclusivas.
  • Networking Global: Conexão direta com pares em 80+ cidades e especialistas setoriais.
  • Transparência: Estrutura de fee-sharing clara que valoriza o trabalho em equipe.
  • Liberdade: Autonomia total para gerir seu negócio com o suporte de uma marca global.


Pronto para elevar o nível da sua assessoria?


Se você tem a experiência e a motivação para expandir sua prática de M&A para além das fronteiras brasileiras, convidamos você a se candidatar para a rede ONEtoONE International .

description:

From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.

  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Developer with experience in developing and maintaining trading applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Redis, and Kafka. Candidates who have experience with Order Management Systems (OMS), exchange connectivity, FIX protocol, execution algorithms will be preferred.

Design, develop, and maintain core components of our Order Management and Execution Management Systems (OMS/EMS).

• Build and enhance exchange and broker connectivity including support for FIX protocol messaging and APIs.

• Work on trade lifecycle management, including order creation, routing, execution, and post-trade processes.

• Collaborate with traders and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Optimize system performance for low latency, high throughput, and fault tolerance.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Available and ready to provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.

English: C2 Proficient
